# GCCP7 Native CLI

> Agent-oriented native operation foundation for Glodon GCCP7. Windows x64 command-line automation for scoped quota lookup, insertion, quantity updates, deletion and audited readback.

面向 AI Agent 的广联达 GCCP7 智能操作底座，适用于已验证范围内的北京2025概算定额业务。

- [README](README.md): Setup, toolchain, scope and usage examples.
- [Agent command map](docs/agent-commands.md): Inputs, effects, JSON results and how to proceed.
- [Agent Skill](.agents/skills/gccp7-native-cli/SKILL.md): Reusable GCCP7 operation instructions for AI agents.
- [Diagnostics](docs/diagnostics.md): Read-only recovery and original command receipts.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): Native execution, safety boundaries and verified cases.
